part.text:
I couldn't open the Notifications tab. This environment has no way to send taps to the simulator, and the bell icon can only be activated by a tap.

I tried opening `https://bsky.app/notifications` through `simctl openurl`. That opened Safari on the logged-out Bluesky web page instead of the app. I then relaunched Bluesky, and it is back in the foreground on the Following feed, with the bell icon still at the bottom right of the tab bar and not yet activated.

To finish the task, someone needs to tap the bell icon (bottom navigation, fourth from left) on the simulator, or the environment needs a tap-capable tool.
